package approvals

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/approvals"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/auditapp/internal/storage/queries/approvals"
)

// RequestStore is the authored approvals adapter.
type RequestStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewRequestStore(db scope.DB) *RequestStore {
	return &RequestStore{db: db}
}

// ApproveTx joins the caller's transaction, so the approval commits only with
// everything else the operation writes there.
func (s *RequestStore) ApproveTx(
	ctx context.Context,
	tx scope.Tx,
	in models.ApproveInput,
) error {
	rows, err := queriesOf(tx).ApproveRequest(
		ctx,
		queries.ApproveRequestParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), ID: in.ID},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if rows != 1 {
		return errors.New("request is not pending")
	}

	return nil
}
